name: Clipboard - Paste Keyboard App
notes: - Added search support within the keyboard.\n- Improved performance.\n- Fixed bugs.

name: ClipboardKeyboard App
notes: Clips can now hold up to 2,500 characters (up from 1,000), so longer notes and messages fit. \nPlus a smoother welcome screen and small fixes.

name: Rocket Keyboard: Text Expander App
notes: - Fixed keyboard height adjustment and kept space above the keyboard.\n- Refined button sizes across iPhone, iPad, and foldable screens.\n- Centered short lists while keeping All on the left and long lists scrollable.

name: PhraseExpress App
notes: Compatibility with latest PhraseExpress Windows and macOS version

name: Clip Keyboard: Paste Snippets App
notes: Sync and backup no longer skip at start.\nThe list stays smooth when tips appear.\nOpening the app is more reliable.

name: Fast Reply: Saved Replies App
notes: New setup walks you through turning on the keyboard and sending your first reply, step by step. You can now browse reply packs right from Home. Small fixes too.

name: Maccy App
notes:
• Added VoiceOver accessibility.
• Added drag and drop reordering of pinned items.
• Added editing of pinned items inside the preview. The Pins settings pane is removed.
• Added support for special symbols as pin keys ([];'./-=\).
• Added image size to the image preview.
• Added support for ignoring apps outside /Applications.
• Improved OCR accuracy with automatic language detection.
• Removed Safari WebArchives and other unselected pasteboard types storage.
• Fixed memory leak of every history item.
• Fixed slow menu bar title rendering with large history.

name: Clipboard Manager: Quick Paste App
notes:
- Dark and light mode.
- Quick preview option.
- Improved visuals and user experience.
- Open links in your browser.

name: OmniKeyboard: Keyboard Toolkit App
notes:
* Projects & To-Do Lists Organize your work with a brand-new Projects section, right inside your keyboard
*  iCloud Sync Fix Resolved a syncing issue; your data now stays in perfect sync across all devices
* Liquid Glass Design  Refreshed UI with Apple's new Liquid Glass aesthetic for iOS 26
* Performance improvements and bug fixes

name: Copy 'Em: Ultimate Clipboard App
notes: Fixed an issue that could cause Copy 'Em to freeze in certain situations.

name: Paste Queue App
notes:
• Added light mode to the app window and refreshed its look.
• Now you can copy a multi-line list, spreadsheet column, or other delimiter-separated text into the app, then split it into separately pastable items using the item’s “...” button > Split into Items.
• Added a new option to show the app window on all Spaces. You can enable it under the app’s gear button > Preferences > General.
• Added an item-separator control to the app window, so you can quickly change or turn off separators before pasting multiple items together.
• This version now requires macOS 14.5 or later.

name: CopyAgain: Copy/Paste Library App
notes:
Smarter ways to copy.

• Placeholders: add {date}, {time} or {clipboard} to a snippet and it fills in when you copy.
• Copy several at once: select a few snippets and copy them as one, line by line or as a bulleted list.
• Copy As: turn a link into a Markdown link or a title with its link, or copy any snippet as a PDF.
• Copy text from an image: pull the words out of a saved picture, all on your device.
• Safer sensitive snippets: copies from your vault stay on this device and clear themselves after a minute.
• CopyAgain no longer asks to save something you just copied from it.

name: Things 3 App
notes:
• Improved performance when loading large lists, including Today, Upcoming, Anytime, Inbox, Trash, projects, and areas.
• Improved recognition of dates typed in the When field.
• Tweaked the layout of the tags dialog and secondary text in dialog rows.
• Fixed a bug where rescheduling a repeating to-do to a date already in its schedule would change its repeat rule.
• Fixed a bug where Things could take several seconds to open on a new day if you had a large Upcoming list and many repeating to-dos.
• Fixed a bug where adding or moving a to-do could cause excessive sync activity.

name: Fantastical Calendar App
notes:
- Added support for iPhone Duo
- Improved duration handling for Todoist tasks created with the natural language parser
- The parser no longer erases manually set due dates when the new sentence doesn't include dates
- Fixed an issue where creating a task in Todoist would add an extra alarm
- Fixed an issue where calendar mirroring could trigger rate limiting from the calendar service
- Various fixes and improvements

By the way, App Store reviews are very helpful to us. If you think Fantastical is worthy, would you mind taking a moment to write a nice review? We'd greatly appreciate it. Thanks

name: Structured: Daily Planner Todo App
notes: This small update focuses on bug fixes and reliability.\n\nThanks for using Structured. Let us know what you think at feedback.structured.app.

name: Todoist: To Do List & Calendar App
notes: We’ve been hard at work squashing bugs, tuning machines, amping up performance, and even taking a few dance breaks in between.\n\nSelect “What’s New” in your settings to view even more polishes and bug squishes.
